jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY

At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.
Tasks & responsibilities

- As part of your role, you will actively support PV systems and contribute to change control processes, ensuring smooth operations and continuous improvement.
- You will provide assistance in the administration of PV systems across all environments, including development, validation, production, and training.
- Moreover, you will guide and support global PV users, helping them navigate system functionalities and fulfill their data retrieval needs efficiently.
- Your responsibilities will include ensuring that the system remains compliant with corporate procedures and meets the requirements of various regulatory authorities.
- You will take ownership of investigating and resolving Level 1 system issues, ensuring timely and effective solutions.
- Additionally, you will execute routine tasks, such as monitoring automated processes, to maintain system reliability and performance.

Additional tasks for Senior Specialist PV Systems and Data Analysis

- As Senior Specialist PV Systems and Data Analysis, you will act as a Subject Matter Expert for PV systems, providing expertise and guidance.
- You will take the lead in implementing PV systems change controls and driving improvements.
- As part of your responsibilities, you will guide and train users, empowering them to utilize the system and retrieve the data they need.
- You will also lead the Change Advisory Board, coordinating and overseeing change management activities.
- Additionally, you will be responsible for investigating and resolving Level 2 system issues, ensuring solutions to maintain system reliability.

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in biology, statistics or IS/IT or apprenticeship with additional education or comparable long-term experience
- Few years of experience working with GxP systems with a focus on system support
- Pharmacovigilance Knowledge
- Experience working with PVWorks, GoTrack, or similar validated databases
- Regulatory and / or Quality Compliance experience
- Proficiency with Microsoft office products, specifically advanced graphing in Excel
- Fluent in spoken and written English

Additional requirements for Senior Specialist PV Systems and Data Analysis

- Bachelor's degree in biology, statistics or IS/IT or apprenticeship with additional education or comparable long-term experience, advanced degree preferred (e.g.: MSc, MBA)
- Several years of experience working with GxP systems with a focus on data analysis
- Experience with Dataland and Dashboards

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.

Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.

With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com

Recruitment process:

Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until 25 September. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand.
Step 2: Virtual meeting in September
Step 3: On-site interviews in September/October

Please submit your application documents in English.

About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) is a
joint venture between four technology leaders, TSMC, Bosch, Infineon
and NXP, to establish a state-of-the-art semiconductor fab in the
heart of Europe. ESMC represents our shared commitment to
strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. To help us build
the foundation of our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a
highly motivated and passionate (m/f/d): Senior Equipment Hook-Up
Engineer As a Senior Equipment Hook-Up Engineer, you will be
coordinating all hook-up activities from planning, construction, and
commissioning of faculty media supplies (gases, chemicals, exhaust
air, ultra-pure water, wastewater, electricity) from the base build
supply connection to the process equipment at our new state-of-the-art
semiconductor fab in Dresden. Your role will ensure system safety,
reliability, efficiency, and compliance while driving continuous
improvement and innovation. You will collaborate with internal teams
and external service providers. Tasks New challenges: Become part of
the facility team to build ESMC's 300mm semiconductor fab. System
Ownership & Optimization: Develop and manage detailed schedules for
equipment hookups, coordinating with equipment vendors, construction
teams, contract vendor management, and facility engineers to ensure
seamless integration in compliance with environmental and safety
regulations. Technical Expertise: Review and approve hookup designs
and engineering plans, ensuring compliance with industry standards and
project specifications. Experience in electrical, process colling
water, ultra-pure water, Gas & Chemical, and other Plastic utility
systems. Data-Driven Decision Making: Monitor and report on the
progress of hookup activities to senior management, addressing any
issues or delays proactively. Project Involvement: Support system
design, construction, and commissioning for new facility installations
and upgrades. Continuous Improvement & Cost Optimization: Plan,
coordinate, and execute strategies to accelerate hookup progress.
Identify opportunities for cost savings, reliability improvements, and
integration of best practices. Collaboration: Lead a team of
technicians and contractors, providing guidance, training, and
performance evaluations. Communicate with cross function engineers or
venders. Profile Job Qualifications: Qualifications and Education:
Degree in Electrical, Chemical, Mechanical or Automation Engineering
or a related field Must have experience: 10+ years of experience in
equipment hookup or facility engineering within the semiconductor
industry. Proven track record in managing large-scale construction or
installation projects. Familiarity with semiconductor fabrication
processes and equipment. Language Skills: Fluent German and English
language skills. Professional Skills: Proficient with Microsoft
Office, discipline-specific software (i.e., AutoCAD, Revit, etc.).
Personal Attributes: Strong analytical thinking and highly effective
interpersonal and communication skills when interacting with others.
Location: Dresden, Germany. What we offer Each journey starts with a
first step. Joining ESMC at this early stage will provide you with the
unique opportunity to actively shape the future of the fab in Dresden,
boost your career and unlock your potential. Work in a fast paced,
international startup environment while at the same time having access
to the experience, talent, and resources of the largest and most
advanced semiconductor manufacturer in the world, TSMC. At ESMC, we
create an inclusive environment to inspire passion and enable the best
in YOU. It is the policy of ESMC to provide equal employment
opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, ethnic and
national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability,
race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender
identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status,
status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other
characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Contact
Please apply with English resume

ist das Joint Venture von TSMC, Bosch, Infineon und NXP. Erstmals
errichtet der weltweite Technologieführer TSMC eine Halbleiterfabrik

wir eine/n hochmotivierte/n und engagierte/n: Quality Management &
Document Control Engineer (m/f/d) Are you ready to shape the quality

As a Quality Management & Document Control Engineer (m/f/d) at ESMC,
you will bridge the gap between our Taiwanese headquarters and our

Continuous Improvement: Track and drive the implementation of

engineering and manufacturing teams to develop and host
quality-related training sessions, workshops, and symposiums. HQ
Collaboration: Leverage resources, documentation standards, and best

framework. Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all document management and
quality processes comply with German/European regulations, customer
requirements, and standard quality frameworks. Profile Must-Have:
Education: Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Engineering, Natural
Sciences, Quality & Reliability, or a related technical field.
Experience: 1 to 3 years of professional experience in the
semiconductor, automotive, or highly regulated electronics
manufacturing industries with a focus on Quality Systems (QS) or
Quality Assurance (QA). Methodology & Tools: Solid familiarity with
standard Quality Control tools, 8D problem-solving methodologies, and
core automotive quality tools (such as SPC, MSA, FMEA, APQP, PPAP).
Languages: Fluency in English (written and spoken) for daily
international collaboration. Working Style: Highly organized,
detail-oriented, and resilient under pressure in a fast-paced
environment. Nice-to-Have: Initial experience or certified
qualification as an auditor (e.g., ISO 9001, IATF 16949, or VDA 6.3).
Basic programming/querying skills in SQL (Structured Query Language)
for quality data extraction. Familiarity with the local German
business ecosystem and manufacturing regulations. Basic conversational
skills in German and/or Mandarin. We offer Help build a completely new
semiconductor manufacturing site in Europe. Work in a highly
international environment with colleagues across Europe, Taiwan and
the US. Shape processes instead of maintaining existing structures.
Participate in global projects and cross-functional collaboration.
International onboarding including approximately 9-12 months of
training in Taiwan. Additional contact details Please apply with your
English resume.

2026 As a Process Engineer, you will play a critical role in
establishing, sustaining, and continuously improving advanced
semiconductor manufacturing processes. With deep technical expertise,
you will use data-driven analysis and structured problem-solving
methodologies to optimize manufacturing performance and support stable
high-volume production. As part of a high-volume 24/7 fab operation,
the role focuses on ensuring tool performance, improving uptime,
reducing defects, and supporting stable production. The position
requires openness to scheduled and occasional shift work, on call
duty, includes an initial induction and training period in Dresden of
one month, followed by one year of on-the-job training in Taiwan. If
you are interested in advancing your career in semiconductor
manufacturing, learning from one of the world’s leading
semiconductor companies, and joining an international and diverse team
on a unique learning journey, apply now with your English CV. Tasks 1.
Design and execute experiments, interpret complex results, and derive
actionable insights from data sets to optimize manufacturing processes
and achieve precision control at atomic levels. 2. Apply statistical
process control methods to establish and sustain robust and stable
manufacturing processes. 3. Qualify and sustain manufacturing
processes to support capacity expansion while maintaining speed,
stability, and quality. 4. Collaborate effectively with equipment and
material suppliers and internal engineering partners to identify
technology gaps, process limitations, and improvement opportunities,
and evaluate sustainable solutions. 5. Drive continuous improvements
in process stability, capability, yield, productivity, quality,
reliability, and safety. 6. Support manufacturing operations in a 24/7
high-volume semiconductor manufacturing environment, including
scheduled evening shifts, weekend support, on-duty, and on-call
responsibilities based on business needs. Profile 1. Legally eligible
to work in Germany. 2. Available for approximately one year of
on-the-job training in Taiwan. 3. Open for scheduled and occasional
shift work, on call duty. 4. Degree in electronics, electrical
engineering, mechanical engineering, mechanics, mechatronics, material
engineering, or an equivalent field. 5. Practical experience in a
mechanical or equipment-related field. 6. Understanding of technical
documentation and schematics. 7. Knowledge of semiconductor
manufacturing is a plus. 8. Fluent in English with good command of
German. 9. Hands-on working attitude with an open mindset. 10. Strong
communication and interpersonal skills. 11. Able to perform physical
work on tools in a cleanroom environment. Important Candidate

1, 2026, in Dresden. Depending on your needs and timeline preferences,
January 1, 2027, can be considered as an alternative start date.
Onboarding and International Training: The first month of your
employment will be spent in Dresden. Following this initial
onboarding, training, and integration with your new team members, you
will travel to Taiwan for a one-year on-the-job training and knowledge
transfer program. Your training in Taiwan will involve close
collaboration with experienced TSMC engineering teams. You may also
receive additional training and support at TSMC’s state-of-the-art
Newcomer Training Center in Taichung. Training Logistics: For
employees requiring accommodation during the first month in Dresden,
and who reside more than 90 minutes away, ESMC will organize
appropriate temporary lodging. This provision does not apply to
employees who establish a residential address in Dresden (e.g., to
expedite work permit procedures away from their original place of
residence) or who terminate a personal lease contract in Dresden prior
to their planned departure to Taiwan. Furthermore, ESMC will organize
and provide air and ground transportation from Dresden to Taichung
(Taiwan) and back at the conclusion of the training. Accommodation in
Taiwan will be provided in one of TSMC’s modern and comfortable
company dormitories. Role Requirements and Expectations: This is a
unique opportunity to gain exposure to TSMC’s world-leading advanced
manufacturing practices and actively contribute to building ESMC from
the ground up. As a start-up organization, ESMC offers the opportunity
to play an active role in shaping the company’s culture, future

a dynamic environment where certain operational details such as
processes, documentation, shift structures, will continue to evolve

In order to fill a fixed-term position in part-time (19.915 hours/week = 50%) January 01, 2027, we are looking for a

Research Associate / Project Coordinator (m/f/d)

The Department of Health Services Research at the Institute of Diversity Medicine, Faculty of Medicine, Ruhr University Bochum, Germany, is seeking to appoint a Research Associate / Project Coordinator (m/f/d) starting 1st of January 2027. The Department of Health Services Research investigates how individual diversity characteristics influence healthcare delivery and develops, implements, and evaluates innovative, patient-centred models of care. Our research focuses on the evaluation of complex interventions, participatory health services research, and the development of diversity-sensitive healthcare concepts. Our interdisciplinary work integrates health services research, public health, social sciences, and medical ethics.

The successful candidate will join the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's Programme DIME – Diversity Medicine, an international initiative to establish a new joint Master's programme together with leading European and international partner universities (e.g. France, Japan, Taiwan). This position offers the unique opportunity to contribute to the development of an innovative international degree programme at the intersection of diversity medicine, global health, and higher education. As Research Associate / Project Coordinator, you will play a central role in coordinating this international consortium. You will collaborate closely with academic partners, university leadership, teaching staff, students, and funding organisations across several countries. The position requires excellent English proficiency, strong interpersonal and diplomatic skills, and outstanding organisational abilities to successfully coordinate complex international collaborations.

Scope: part-time
Duration: fixed-term, 15 Monate
Start: January 01, 2027
Apply by:  2026-09-28

Your tasks:

- Contribute to the scientific development and evaluation of the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's Programme DIME - Diversity Medicine, including literature reviews and the preparation of scientific materials
- Support the collection, analysis and interpretation of data related to teaching, programme evaluation and research activities within DIME
- Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations and the dissemination of research findings
- support the coordination of academic activities within DIME, including communication with partner universities, students and visiting academics
- Assist in organising consortium meetings, workshops and selected international programme activities conducted in English
- Contribute to project documentation, reporting and the preparation of presentations and other project materials

Your profile:

- Master's degree (or equivalent university qualification) in Public Health, Health Sciences, Medicine, Health Services Research, Social Sciences, Psychology, Medical Ethics, Higher Education Management, or a related field
- Strong interest in diversity medicine, international higher education, and collaborative research
- A very good command of written and spoken English is essential, as English is the working language of the consortium and virtually all communication is conducted in English
- Excellent communication, networking, and interpersonal skills
- Outstanding diplomatic skills, intercultural competence, and confidence in working with partners from diverse academic, cultural, and professional backgrounds
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to independently manage complex international coordination processes
- Highly structured, proactive, solution-oriented, and reliable working style with a strong sense of responsibility
- Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within an international team
- Experience in international project management, Erasmus+, Erasmus Mundus, university administration, or comparable international projects is desirable
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications

jobs.description:
In order to fill a fixed-term position in full-time (39.83 hours/week = 100%) at the earliest possible date, we are looking for a

Research associate (m/f/x) in Data Science in Chemistry

At the Chair of Inorganic Chemistry II of the Ruhr University Bochum we address research questions in the fields of organometallic synthesis chemistry and homogeneous catalysis. We are an internationally oriented research team that develops new reagents as well as highly efficient catalysts for synthetic chemistry. By combining advanced synthetic methods, state of the art analytical techniques, quantum chemical calculations, and machine learning methods, we conduct world leading research at the highest international level. Automated analysis of chemical data and the prediction of reactivity, selectivity and yield by means of machine learning are revolutionising modern chemistry. In our group we employ data science methods together with quantum chemical calculations to model reaction networks from experimental data, understand bonding situations and reactivities, and identify new catalysts and reaction conditions in a data driven way.

The Chair of Inorganic Chemistry II (Organometallic Chemistry and Homogeneous Catalysis) is looking for a full time scientific staff member (postdoctoral researcher) (100 % TV L 13) to start immediately. We are looking for a motivated postdoctoral researcher (m/f/x) who, with a passion for interdisciplinary work, will support the design of teaching courses in data science and machine learning and strengthen our group in this area.

Scope: full-time
Duration: fixed-term, 2 Jahre
Start: at the earliest possible date
Apply by:  2026-09-21

Your tasks:

- Quantum‑chemical calculations – perform calculations to elucidate reaction mechanisms, bonding situations and to extract physicochemical properties of molecules
- Model development & validation – create and validate models that clarify structure‑activity relationships and predict properties and reactivities; analyse data with statistical methods and visualise the results
- Collaboration with experimentalists – work closely with laboratory scientists to support and validate data collection
- Project leadership – take responsibility for projects, supervise students, write reports and grant proposals
- Scientific communication – compile results into publications and assist students in preparing manuscripts
- Mentorship – supervise students in their theses and support teaching activities in the areas of Data Science and Machine Learning
- Teaching – support the development and implementation of new student courses in Data Science and Machine Learning

Your profile:

A candidate with a completed university degree and a PhD (preferred) in Chemistry is sought; candidates from related fields such as Data Science or Computer Science with demonstrable knowledge of chemistry are also welcome.

Further requirements:

- Practical experience in quantum‑chemical calculations – familiarity with common quantum‑chemical programs and methods, in particular ORCA, Multiwfn, AIM, etc.
- Practical experience in machine learning & chemistry‑specific data science – programming skills in Python and hands‑on experience with standard libraries such as NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Scikit‑learn, RDKit, PyTorch, etc.
- Practical experience in homogeneous catalysis – desirable, but not mandatory
- Practical experience with the installation and maintenance of high-performance computing clusters – desirable, but not mandatory
- Theoretical knowledge in quantum-chemistry, machine learning, molecular chemistry
- Experience in research project management
- Experience in publishing and presenting scientific results
- Experience in teaching and the supervision of students and interns
- Language skills – English (fluent spoken and written) is required; German is an advantage but not mandatory

Furthermore, the applicant should be open to team‑oriented work and possess a strong motivation for interdisciplinary research.

jobs.description:
A major focus of our research is the development of PROTACs as novel therapeutic approaches against cancer. Our research combines molecular genetics, biochemistry, cell biology, and cancer models. Recently published studies: Müller et al, EMBO Rep. 2026; Bhandare et al, Nucleic Acids Research, 2025; Vogt et al, Gut, 2024; Solvie et al, Nature 2022; Narain et al, Molecular Cell

Further information about our work can be found at:  www.biochemie-kiel.de/research-groups/wolf-group/  You will work on an ERC (European Research Council) or German Cancer Aid funded project. The research group is located at the Institute of Biochemistry, which is part of the Medical Faculty of the University of Kiel. The institute provides excellent facilities and state-of-the-art equipment, allowing you to perform cutting-edge experiments and acquire highly valuable skills for a future career in academia or industry. The department is located at the heart of the Kiel University campus, which provides a stimulating collaborative research environment with multiple research groups working on tumor biology and cellular proteolysis. We collaborate with numerous additional life science institutes in Kiel including the Kiel Oncology Network (KON), the Institute of Pharmacy and Kiel Life Science (KLS). - You are highly motivated and are eager to pursue a Ph.D. in the natural sciences with a medical focus.

- You have recently completed, or are about to complete, your Master's degree in biochemistry, molecular biology, cell biology, bioinformatics or a related field.
- You have excellent written and spoken English skills. Knowledge of German is desirable but not required.
- You enjoy working with young researchers in an international and collaborative team. The positions will start between December 2026 and March 2027 and the salary is based on TV-L E 13 (65%). In case of equivalent qualifications, disabled applicants will be preferentially considered.

Who we are

TK Elevator (TKE) is a global leader in vertical transportation and urban mobility. We provide engineering that keeps the world moving, including design, installation, and maintenance of elevators, escalators, walkways, lifts, passenger boarding bridges, stairlifts, platform lifts and home elevators – including multi-brand modernization and service any place, any time. jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher Position— Plant Membrane Biochemistry and Chemoproteomics (m/f/d)  (10/2026) (UX-Researcher/in)
jobs.description:
Your area of responsibility The question How does proteolytic regulation control plant plasma-membrane receptor function and plant immune responses? The plant plasma membrane is a dynamic hub for nutrient uptake, pathogen detection and stress signalling, anchored by surface receptors. In animals, proteolytic cleavage of membrane proteins is a major regulatory mechanism in immunity. In plants, its role remains largely unexplored. FRONTERA, funded by the European Research Council through an ERC Starting Grant, sets out to close that gap. The project combines chemoproteomics, cell biology, protease biochemistry and genetics, and looks at both sides of the process: the proteases that cut, and the substrates they act on. It is curiosity-driven research with a long view towards crop resilience and sustainable agriculture. Your tasks: You will lead the membrane biochemistry and chemoproteomics side of FRONTERA: establishing the preparations and the activity-based profiling needed to study proteases where they work, at the plant plasma membrane.
• Develop and optimise membrane preparation methods suited to downstream chemoproteomics
• Apply activity-based protein profiling and mass spectrometry to characterise membrane-associated protease activities, working with our in-house facility
• Relate biochemical findings to immune responses in planta, in collaboration across the group
• Co-supervise a doctoral researcher
• Present and publish your scientific data

Your profile Essential
• A doctoral degree in biochemistry, plant science, molecular biology, chemical biology or a closely related field. If your thesis is submitted but not yet defended by the start date, please apply and tell us your timeline.
• Solid hands-on experience in protein biochemistry
• Real interest in method development, including tolerance for the weeks when a protocol refuses to work
• Interest in mentoring a doctoral researcher
• Excellent English language skills, written and spoken. German is not required.

Desirable
• Membrane protein handling, subcellular fractionation or membrane isolation
• Activity-based protein profiling, chemical probes or related chemical biology
• LC-MS/MS proteomics, from sample preparation to data analysis
• Work with plant systems, including transient expression
• Proteomics data analysis (MaxQuant, FragPipe, Perseus, R, Python)
• Supervision or teaching experience

Read the second list as a description of the project, not a test. Nobody arrives with all of it. Candidates who would do this job well routinely talk themselves out of applying because they match four points instead of six. If the science interests you and you bring the essentials, we would like to see your application. Tell us in your cover letter what you would need to learn.

We offer
• Modern Working Conditions: Comprehensive introduction to work techniques and a modern research environment with state-of-the-art equipment and up-to-date software
• Career Development: Targeted training opportunities and access to a specialized library with electronic resources and quiet workspaces
• Compensation & Security: Classification according to TV-L including annual bonus, pension scheme (VBL), health offers, and discounted canteen meals
• Ideal Working Environment: A varied and inspiring workplace in an international setting at a leading scientific and innovation hub
• Team Spirit and Leadership Culture: An open culture that strengthens teamwork, enables career networking, and promotes your research skills.
• Work-Life Balance: Flexible working models, remote work options, and 30 days of annual leave – for a balanced work-life experience.

About us The Independent Research Group Receptor Biochemistry, led by Dr. Mariana Schuster, is dedicated to understanding and engineering the molecular decisions that determine whether a plant gets sick, focusing on the proteases deployed by plants and pathogens and the proteins they cut. We are small, international and deliberately interdisciplinary. People here come from plant science, biochemistry, chemistry and computational backgrounds, and much of the useful thinking happens in the conversations between them. The IPB is a non-university research institute of the Leibniz Association on the Weinberg Campus of Martin Luther University Halle-Wittenberg, a foundation under public law under the direct supervision of the state of Saxony-Anhalt. Around 200 people work here, including about 40 doctoral researchers, across four scientific departments and two independent research groups. Research at the IPB aims to understand the (bio)chemical basis of plant resilience and performance in challenging environments related to climate change. The IPB offers excellent research facilities and state-of-the-art infrastructure, including in-house mass spectrometry. More at ipb-halle.de. Halle (Saale) is a green, walkable city with a large student population, low living costs by German standards, and fast connections to Leipzig and Berlin.

Dr. Mariana Schuster
Head of Research Group

Would you like to do more than simply observe and instead actively contribute to challenging transformation projects in an international environment?

Who We Are

We are a specialized boutique consultancy in the field of digital transformation, with a focus on:

- Process management
- Project management
- Quality assurance in ERP projects
- ERP solution architecture in the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations environment
- Data analytics and business intelligence

We are looking for motivated seasoned veterans (m/f/d) who have extensive professional experience and would like to learn something new in the areas of project management (Office) and control tower functions in ERP implementation projects.

Our ambition is not only to deliver successful projects, but also to support the professional development of people.

About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

**AGGP2027 – Graduate Business Information Technologist **

Start date - October 2027

Are you a university graduate with the aspiration, enthusiasm, and talent to help us pioneer sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world? Every year, Airbus seeks bright minds from around the globe to fill critical roles that will shape our future.

When you begin your career with us, we don't just offer a job; we accelerate your growth through the Airbus Global Graduate development journey. This isn't a one-size-fits-all program; it's a personalized, two-year experience designed to cultivate your professional skills, enhance your business acumen, and hone your technical abilities. We place a strong emphasis on developing your leadership potential from day one. You'll gain a unique perspective on the world of Airbus while contributing directly in a specific, impactful position.

During the two years, we will take you on a soft-skill development journey, covering such areas as inclusive leadership, our Values, resilience, communication and emotional intelligence, with various in-person and virtual workshops.

Beyond your daily responsibilities and this comprehensive schedule of training, you'll join your global graduate community annually for an in-person dedicated development week. This is your chance to connect with your peers, learn directly from our seasoned leaders, and gain insights from the best in the industry.

Throughout the programme, you will be developed into an established and valuable team member from day 1. You'll sharpen your skills in an area strategically important to Airbus, gaining a deep understanding of our business – its opportunities, challenges, and needs. Most importantly, you'll have learned more about yourself and what makes you truly great. You will have demonstrated your capability and readiness to take on future leadership challenges within Airbus.

Above all, you'll have the unparalleled opportunity to do your best work in an industry that is literally reshaping how we live in our world.

If you're ready to embark on this transformative journey and unlock your full potential, apply below.

** What you will be doing**

You will be on a development journey to guide your growth into the role of Business Information Technologist and can expect to be involved in the following:

1. Analyzing business information requirements and preparing business information strategies

2. Preparing business decision regarding business information management

3. Lead projects of implementation of business information tool, systems and processes

4. Collaboration with various internal and external stakeholders

5. Understanding of project development and administrative processes

6. Supporting business development, sales and bid activities

7. Rotational placement activity will include: central services including IT infrastructure, IT network support and development, IT Security, Digital development incliding AI projects, Programme/Projects and Project Controlling, Sales & Marketing.

Your development journey will include a minimum of one rotational placement to support your growth into position, one of them (1-3 months) may be conducted at Tesat GmbH, Backnang/Germany.

At the end of the two year development programme, you will have developed into the position of Business Information Technologist.

** What we are looking for**

To be a successful applicant, you will need to demonstrate you have:

- A degree level or equivalent within Information Technology

- Recently graduated or first professional experience in the field of Business Information Technology

- Strong verbal and written communication in our local language (German) and business language (English)

- A desire to work in a collaborative team environment, focused on driving future innovation

- The ability to be self aware and a wish to be in the driving seat of your development.

Please note, we love your interest in working for Airbus but we do ask that you make only one application to the Airbus Global Graduate Programme. Take the time to decide which of our exciting opportunities is right for you and then submit an application that best represents you, your skills and experience in connection with the role you have selected.

STATEMENT: This position requires a security clearance (ITAR).

What is the recruitment process…

Online application -> Online Task Based Assessment -> Application Review (Talent Acquisition Partner & Manager) -> Virtual Assessment Centre -> Offer!

NB: Applications will close 30 September 2026 (don’t delay, apply early as some roles may close before this date due to applications received). All applications and CVs need to be in English.

Please let us know if you need us to make any adjustments. Examples of this may include (but is not exclusive to) accessible facilities and additional time for written exercises etc. Any information disclosed will be treated in the strictest confidence.
